issues.description: The type of the Bitmap24::width attribute differs between the template and the solution. In the template header Bitmap24::width is declared as 'short' while in the solution it is declared as 'int'. This mismatch is likely unintentional and can confuse students (and cause truncation/overflow issues when large widths are used). The Bitmap24.cpp constructor takes int parameters for width/height which aligns with the solution's int width, increasing the likelihood that the template's 'short' is an oversight.
issues.suggestedFix: Use the same type for width in the template header as in the solution (change Bitmap24::width from 'short' to 'int' in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp) so the header, implementation and solution are consistent and large image widths are not truncated.
